title: Daily Workout · November 8
note: Sunday recovery session · 40 minutes. Gentle walking, mobility, and light stability work. Keep effort easy and conversational. No jogging or heavy lifting today. Avoid breath-holding and stop for chest discomfort, dizziness, unusual palpitations, or groin, knee, or back pain. Progression remains conservative until actual workout completion and recovery data are available.

items.name: Shoulder rolls and arm circles
items.instructions: Keep shoulders relaxed and movements controlled.

items.name: Standing hip flexor stretch
items.instructions: Small stance and neutral pelvis; skip if groin pulls.

items.name: Seated upper-back rotations
items.instructions: Rotate gently without twisting lower back.

items.name: Easy warm-up
items.instructions: Start slowly and settle into comfortable breathing.

items.name: Comfortable steady walk
items.instructions: Easy conversational pace; no jog intervals. Slow down if needed.

items.name: Cool-down
items.instructions: Gradually slow until breathing is comfortable.

items.name: Bodyweight glute bridges
items.instructions: Gentle glute squeeze; do not arch lower back or strain groin.

items.name: Wall push-ups
items.instructions: Use a comfortable wall distance; avoid elbow pain and breath-holding.

items.name: Bird dogs
items.instructions: Small reach; keep back and hips steady.

items.name: Dead bugs
items.instructions: Keep knees bent and movement pain-free; shorten reach if needed.
